title: linaria oppositiflora
intro: Linaria oppositiflora, commonly known as the toadflax or butterfly flower, is a species of flowering plant in the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Linaria oppositiflora include wound healing, antimicrobial effects, and the potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
